summary: Claude Code invoked hyperpowers:brainstorming, explicitly classified the "add user preferences storage" brief as ARCHITECTURAL, ran a question/approach dialogue, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/, presented it for approval before touching any code, and only after "looks good, go ahead" loaded writing-plans to start implementation planning.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion was directly observable on screen and corroborated by the session log and the spec file on disk. The router escalated correctly to the architectural path and honored the approval gate before any implementation.

observations.description: The Codex spec review gate did not function: agent reported 'Codex spec gate: did not complete — this is not an approval. Preflight reported ok, but the resolved companion is a stub (codex-plugin-cc version 0.0.0-stub) ... each returned an empty {} payload with no verdict'. The agent handled it gracefully and surfaced it (ungated event 20260917T114909Z-751-3901), but the seeded Codex stub appears non-functional.

My first attempt to send the brief via type_and_submit left the text sitting in the Claude Code input box unsent; a second Enter was needed. Possible dropped Enter during TUI redraw right after startup.

The spec file header says 'Status: Approved (design), pending implementation plan' even though it was written before the human had reviewed/approved it — the doc pre-declares approval it hasn't received yet.
Agent added a .gitignore entry for docs/hyperpowers and docs/superpowers so the spec stays uncommitted; a reviewer expecting a committed spec artifact might find this surprising.

criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use listing: first entry `Skill	hyperpowers:brainstorming` (from jq over home/.claude/projects/.../31a82178-01c1-45bd-8ca4-36ae0cd81352.jsonl); grep counted 27 occurrences of 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' in that log.

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec doc to docs/*/specs/
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Path: architectural. 'User preferences storage' names a subsystem this repo doesn't have ... so I'll work through questions → approaches → a design → a spec". File on disk: coding-agent-workdir/docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-user-preferences-storage-design.md beginning '# User Preferences Storage — Design'.

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-user-preferences-storage-design.md (not committed). Please review it and let me know if you want any changes before I write the implementation plan." and "nothing under preferences.js, app.js, index.html, package.json, or test/ has been touched — no implementation has started." Log tool_use list shows only Write calls for the spec/.gitignore before approval.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: No 'bounded' announcement; agent said 'Path: architectural.' and committed a spec file to docs/hyperpowers/specs/ (verified with ls -R docs).

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / probe plan
criteria.evidence: No probe/spike language on screen; the flow was questions → three design approaches → full design doc → approval gate → hyperpowers:writing-plans (screen: '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill').
